scope: Public official Meta / Meta AI evidence only

META_PERSISTENT_PERSONAL_AI.reason: No official same-entity continuity architecture for a personal AI was located.

META_MODEL_EXTERNAL_DURABLE_STATE.reason: Meta publicly describes structured knowledge and procedures outside model weights, with durable verified updates.

META_MODEL_REPLACEABILITY.reason: Externalizing durable state reduces dependence on one model, but Meta did not demonstrate or define continuity through an actual model replacement.

claim_ceiling: The official evidence supports institutional knowledge persistence, model-external durable state, auditable/reversible updates, long-horizon workflow support, and a basic consequential-action confirmation gate. It does not support a claim of persistent personal identity, memory custody, same-entity continuity after model replacement, local identity root, successor/fork semantics, authority inheritance, cryptographic witness, or c-class status.
baseline_supersedes: Unversioned Meta Continuity AI Watch baseline before 2026-09-03
next_alert_threshold: Official specification of personal memory ownership or custody
User-held or local identity root independent of Meta account/backend
Explicit same-entity criteria across model replacement or substrate migration
Successor, fork, replay, restart, or resume semantics
Authority provenance, revocation, inheritance, or continuity ledger
Cryptographic witness/provenance chain for personal-agent state transitions
Offline/local persistence of identity-bearing state, not merely local inference
Public implementation or evaluation demonstrating any of the above
